function.name: book_viewing
function.description: Book a property viewing in the calendar and text the lead a confirmation. Only call after the lead has clearly agreed to a specific slot returned by check_availability. Use the exact startISO value from that tool.

startISO.description: Exact start time of the chosen slot, ISO 8601, copied from check_availability.

email.description: Lead's email address if they offered it.

listing.description: Listing id or address the viewing is for.

notes.description: Anything the agent should know before the viewing.
